item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 17/Oct/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The easterly airstream now affecting the coast of Guangdong will continue to moderate tomorrow. Meanwhile, an upper-air disturbance will bring a few showers to the northern part of the South China Sea. An easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China gradually during the weekend, it will be windy and generally fine over the region early next week. Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, it is expected to be slightly cooler in the morning and at night over Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large.
